description: O11: the REFUSAL of a set Identifier that collides with the name of another record of the same static entity. Without this pre-check the native setter would add a suffix SILENTLY (Active -> Active2), like the Studio grid; the kernel checks the clash in the scope before writing, as the rename already did, and refuses, saying the name the Studio would use. The clean path (Identifier to a free name, with the consumers rewritten) is in tests/jobs/static-entity-lifecycle.json. Measured with the base job:spec-data.
expectError: set Identifier: 'Active' clashes with an existing name in that scope

ops._why: the record that will try to change its name: Identifier = Inactive.
the name that already exists in the same scope: Identifier = Active.
refused with "op #2 (set Identifier): InvalidOperationException: set Identifier: 'Active' clashes with an existing name in that scope (the Studio would use 'Active2'); pick another identifier".
